svg.text: Ordinal Rank Placement on the Jig
Every hole = the intersection of two datum planes. Rank the holes' columns/rows 1..N so each plane lands on the right side of the index.
X-plane · col N=3
Z-plane · row N=2
INDEX hole
= X-plane ∩ Z-plane (IndexNX=3, IndexNZ=2)
X (cols)
Z (rows)
CSYS_PAT_DEF
model axes — reliable,
not the null-normal index csys

g.text: X columns, ranked ascending N = 1 .. Nx

svg.text: The rule that keeps planes on the right side
LOOP-BASED PARSING
① collapse holes to distinct columns / rows
② rank each ascending: N = 1 .. count
③ build the plane at its ABSOLUTE coord
off CSYS_PAT_DEF (not a signed offset)
RelN = N − IndexN, Direction = sign(RelN)
Why it works: absolute-coordinate order IS
column order. N > IndexN ⇒ larger coord ⇒ lands
on the + side automatically. No negative offsets,
no dependence on the csys axis sign.
PROBLEM
Old way: offset each plane off the index csys
by (coord − index). Its axes read null — so the
− side resolved to the WRONG side.
Corner index → always worked. Interior → scattered.
